cwe_content.cwe: CWE-434,Unrestricted Upload of File with Dangerous Type

candidate.Reason: This function only checks the file extension from the original_name parameter and appends it to new_name without validating if the extension matches the actual file content. This allows for potential extension manipulation.

This function processes file uploads but only checks file size and uses the potentially manipulated file extension from append_file_num_postfix. It doesn't validate the actual file content against the extension.
This function resolves uploads from URLs but doesn't perform any validation on the file content or extension, potentially allowing dangerous file types to be processed.
